text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During those first three years, Narita Top Road
achieved brilliant results. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't the only one shining during those three years.
It was a golden age of great prosperity for the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Golden Generation and those who followed them.
It was truly a glorious era where titans clashed.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Eternity does not exist. One after another,
star Umamusume become legends."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "All right! I'm not gonna lose to you, Cafe!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm in your care, Pokke-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eras shift.
The terrifying delinquent, "Jungle Pocket."
The mysterious girl, "Manhattan Cafe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Umamusume were now standing
at the center of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
By the way... Pokke-san. Do you know?
About the legendary generation.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A generation that had become a legend to aspire to. The Golden Generation, and the Umamusume who followed them.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ha, only a little! But legends exist
to be surpassed, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: We're doing it, Cafe! You and me together!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Legends only get more exaggerated the more time passes. As if I'd ever bow down to something like that.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The past is the past! The present is the present!
Let's show them we're several cuts above...
Well then, let's give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You are...

The Golden Generation... is no illusion.
It truly was a magnificent generation.

That high level of skill still holds up today.
However, unless they feel it firsthand, they won't understand.
Furthermore, there are countless fans who wish to keep watching you forever. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even now, I am still here.
To win using that very power.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So you've arrived...
The incarnation of light... the living legend...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Bring it on! I've been itching to take you on on this stage!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Show me on the battleground!
I swear—I'll surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do our best.

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaahhh--!!
Uoraaaaaaaah--!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Eternity does not exist. Yet even as time passes,
there is one... who keeps running on."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Not yet! This is our true power!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inheriting the legend—as a beacon of light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The same day, in Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Phew, this is nice.
Strolling around like this once in a while.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Are you having fun, Doto?
Are you truly relaxing from the bottom of your heart?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes~, Opera O-san.
I'm still not quite used to it, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Stepping away from racing for a bit
might not be a bad idea either.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Yet even at this very moment—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You must be running right now, aren't you?
Under the same cherry blossoms as back then.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I have to take off my hat to such devotion.
And then—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san, I'll be waiting! For good news!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Keep singing of our lofty ambitions
to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I can still keep going!
For the next race, more, more, more...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Lately, some of the girls have grown stronger,
and we've had new Umamusume join us as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "As long as the fans keep cheering for me, I want to run! I want to reach them!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The passion of racing, its sheer wonder, and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fun!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's see this through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Tap-chan,
thank you for our first race together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Such a run full of romance,
I was deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, I can't reach her... On top of being strong, she has this kind of leadership...
She's way too big of a deal.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Argh, I lost, I lost! But just you watch. I'm definitely gonna surpass your caliber!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san, Fine-chan,
Shakur-chan, Mirako-chan,
thank you all for your help today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's an honor to run alongside all of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Fumu―― The honor is... mine, too.
The Legend, Narita Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing, isn't it?
To think she's been running all this time without stopping.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And with zero decay, no less.
Good grief, you really are a total enigma.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I guess I'm just happy.
Getting to run together with you feels like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road continues to run.
Down the endless road.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just forging straight ahead,
illuminating countless Umamusume
with that brilliant radiance."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to keep moving forward with you...
forever and ever.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The path doesn't end at the peak!
The path of light stretches far beyond the summit, continuing endlessly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Narita Top Road.
A beacon of hope shining through the ages.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That path reached the summit, went beyond the sky,
and now—it continues into the present.
